description: Final integration: update governance __init__.py to export new modules, verify all tests pass together, commit all changes with meaningful message.
steps: Update src/nexus/governance/__init__.py to import and export new modules: PolicyEngine from policies, SecretVault from secrets, PersistentAuditLogger from audit_persistent, ComplianceFramework from compliance, RateLimiter from rate_limiter, TenantGuard from tenant_guard, RollbackManager from rollback, IncidentManager from incidents, RetentionManager from retention, HealthMonitor from health, ConfigGovernance from config_governance.
Run full AST validation on all new files: python -c to parse every new .py file
Run full test suite: python -m pytest tests/ -x -q to verify no regressions

Git add all new files and commit with message: 'feat: Phase 5 - Advanced Governance & Production Hardening

- Policy engine with deterministic evaluation, built-in safety policies
- Secret vault with Fernet encryption, access control, rotation
- Persistent audit logger with hash chain tamper detection
- Compliance framework with data classification
- Token bucket rate limiter with sliding window
- Tenant guard with hard isolation enforcement
- Rollback manager with cascading undo and safety checks
- Incident manager with auto-detection and timeline

acceptance_criteria: All Python files in the project pass AST parsing
Full test suite passes (both existing and new tests)
All changes are committed to git
verification: python -c "import ast, pathlib; errors = []; [errors.append(str(f)) if not (lambda p: (ast.parse(p.read_text()), True)[-1])(f) else None for f in pathlib.Path('src').rglob('*.py')]; print(f'{len(list(pathlib.Path("src").rglob("*.py")))} files parsed OK') if not errors else print(errors)"
